<style>
.gq{margin:1rem 0 1.6rem;padding:.8rem .9rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--site-surface)}
.gq-title{font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.gq-card{font-size:1.1rem;margin:.3rem 0 .6rem}.gq-who{color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.gq-btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem}
.gq-btns .gq-right{background:#2b9c90;color:#fff;border-color:#2b9c90}.gq-btns .gq-wrong{background:#d6336c;color:#fff;border-color:#d6336c}
.gq-fb{margin:.6rem 0;min-height:1.4rem}.gq-fb.ok{color:#1d7a70}.gq-fb.no{color:#a61e4d}
.gq-foot{display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:center}.gq-score{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.85rem}
.gv-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;margin:.35rem 0}
.tg-play{font:inherit;font-size:.8rem;width:1.9rem;padding:.05rem 0;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:4px;background:var(--site-surface);cursor:pointer}
.tg-play.on{background:var(--site-accent);color:#fff}
.gv-quote{border-left:3px solid var(--site-accent);padding:.3rem .9rem;margin:.8rem 0;background:var(--site-surface)}
</style>
